# Alpine Peak Roofing

> Pinnacle of Protection, Peak of Performance. Alpine Peak Roofing is a licensed and insured Colorado roofing contractor serving the Denver metro area and Colorado's mountain communities with residential, commercial, and 24/7 emergency roofing services since 1989.

## About

- **Company name:** Alpine Peak Roofing (Alpine Peak Roofing LLC)
- **Slogan:** Pinnacle of Protection, Peak of Performance
- **Founded:** 1989
- **Headquarters region:** Denver metro area, Colorado, United States
- **Service region:** Denver metropolitan area and Colorado mountain communities, including the Central Rockies, Summit County, San Juan Mountains, Fraser Valley, Yampa Valley, and Western Slope
- **Licensing:** Licensed and insured in Colorado
- **Specialties:** High-altitude mountain roofing, luxury residential roofing, commercial roofing systems (TPO, EPDM, modified bitumen, standing seam metal), storm and hail damage repair, historic preservation roofing, and sustainable roofing solutions
- **Manufacturer certifications and partnerships:** GAF (architectural and impact-resistant shingle systems), premium standing-seam metal manufacturers, Vermont natural slate quarries, premium Western Red Cedar shake suppliers
- **Professional affiliations:** National Roofing Contractors Association (NRCA), Better Business Bureau
- **Core differentiators:** Specialized engineering for high-altitude conditions (reduced atmospheric pressure, intense UV, extreme freeze-thaw cycles, heavy snow loads up to 200 psf), National Historic Landmark preservation experience (Telluride), and 24/7 emergency storm response across the state

## Service Areas

Alpine Peak Roofing maintains 24/7 emergency response capability across the Denver metro area and the following Colorado mountain communities. Each page below contains climate data, elevation, and locally relevant roofing guidance.

- [Aspen](https://alpinepeakroofing.com/locations/aspen) — Central Rockies, 7,908 ft elevation; luxury estates and Victorian restoration.
- [Vail](https://alpinepeakroofing.com/locations/vail) — Central Rockies, 8,150 ft base / 11,570 ft summit; 300+ in. annual snowfall.
- [Telluride](https://alpinepeakroofing.com/locations/telluride) — San Juan Mountains, 8,750 ft; National Historic Landmark district preservation.
- [Crested Butte](https://alpinepeakroofing.com/locations/crested-butte) — Central Rockies, 8,885 ft; record snowfall exceeding 500 in./yr.
- [Steamboat Springs](https://alpinepeakroofing.com/locations/steamboat-springs) — Yampa Valley, 6,732 ft; resort and working-ranch roofing.
- [Winter Park](https://alpinepeakroofing.com/locations/winter-park) — Fraser Valley, 9,052 ft; Continental Divide weather exposure.
- [Breckenridge](https://alpinepeakroofing.com/locations/breckenridge) — Summit County, 9,600 ft; Colorado's highest incorporated city.
- [Frisco](https://alpinepeakroofing.com/locations/frisco) — Summit County, 9,097 ft; hub for five major ski areas.
- [Silverthorne](https://alpinepeakroofing.com/locations/silverthorne) — Summit County, 8,790 ft; contemporary mountain architecture.
- [Glenwood Springs](https://alpinepeakroofing.com/locations/glenwood-springs) — Western Slope, 5,761 ft; geothermal microclimate considerations.
- [Durango](https://alpinepeakroofing.com/locations/durango) — San Juan Region, 6,512 ft; Old West heritage and four-season climate.
- [Central Mountains Service Area](https://alpinepeakroofing.com/service-areas/central-mountains) — Multi-peak coverage across Summit, Eagle, and Pitkin counties.

## Materials

Alpine Peak Roofing installs four premium roofing systems, each specified for Colorado's altitude, UV exposure, and snow-load requirements.

- [GAF Timberline HDZ Architectural Shingles](https://alpinepeakroofing.com/materials/gaf-timberline) — Lifetime warranty, 30–50 year lifespan, Class A fire, Class 4 impact (HDZ IR variant) available for hail-prone Front Range markets.
- [Standing Seam Metal Roofing](https://alpinepeakroofing.com/materials/standing-seam) — 24-gauge steel with Kynar 500 finish, 40–70+ year lifespan, 140–180 mph wind rating, superior snow shedding for mountain homes.
- [Natural Slate Roofing](https://alpinepeakroofing.com/materials/natural-slate) — Quarried Vermont and imported slate, 75–200+ year lifespan, Class A fire rating, the most prestigious roof available.
- [Premium Cedar Shake Roofing](https://alpinepeakroofing.com/materials/cedar-shake) — Premium-grade Western Red Cedar, 30–50 year lifespan with maintenance, natural R-6.0 per inch insulation, authentic mountain aesthetic.
- [Materials overview and comparison](https://alpinepeakroofing.com/materials)
